intro: A torn strip of cloth taken from the standards of Warlord Krom'zar, commander of the Kolkar retaliatory force. It serves as tangible proof to Regthar Deathgate that the centaur invasion from Desolace has been broken.

p: Following the systematic defeat of Kolkar chieftains across the Barrens, a furious warband marched east from Desolace intent on revenge. Led by Warlord Krom'zar, these invaders assaulted the defensive bunkers west of the Crossroads. Slicing a remnant from the warlord's fallen battle standard provides undeniable proof to Regthar Deathgate that the assault was crushed and the southern trade routes preserved for the Horde.
